Thanks again for the interest — excited to walk through a tailored run of Redwood Inference for your infra and procurement teams. To make sure we have the right folks (AE + SE deep dive + your procurement/security), I sketched a few time options next week and one lightweight rotation plan so we don't keep shifting the same slot. See the attached agenda (demo-agenda.pdf).

Option 1 (EU-friendly):
- Tue 11 May 2027 — 09:30–11:00 BST (UK) / 04:30–06:00 ET / 01:30–03:00 PT

Option 2 (US-friendly evening, usable for APAC one-off):
- Wed 12 May 2027 — 20:00–21:30 PT / 23:00–00:30 ET / 04:00–05:30 SGT (next day)

Option 3 (Short split sessions — reduces overlap pressure):
- Thu 13 May 2027 — EU session 09:00–09:45 BST; APAC session 02:00–02:45 SGT (we'd run SE deep-dive in the shorter slot)

If none of these are workable, we can do a 2-week rotating cadence: Week A = EU morning, Week B = APAC morning, and SE + AE alternate the start time so your team doesn't have to join at 03:00 regularly. Marcus is copied and happy to run the SE portion and propose a split agenda if helpful.

Would you prefer a single combined 90-min session or two focused 45-min sessions across two timezones? Also looping procurement if we need PO/terms pre-reads.

Thanks — I can send calendar invites for two candidate slots once you confirm which option is preferred.

Best,

Thanks — quick ops proposal to minimize follow-up scheduling friction:

1) Two-session plan (recommended):
- Session A (Week A) — EU-friendly full demo: Tue 11 May 09:30–11:00 BST (90 mins) — Exec overview + SE run-through.
- Session B (Week B) — APAC-friendly split: Wed 19 May 02:00–02:45 SGT (45 mins SE deep-dive) + 02:45–03:15 SGT (optional Q&A / procurement).

2) Rotation rule: alternate the longer session between EU and APAC weeks so the same people are not repeatedly joining at 02:00. Practically: Week 1 = EU long, Week 2 = APAC short, Week 3 = EU short, Week 4 = APAC long. That gives both sides a reasonable daytime cadence every 2 weeks.

3) Deliverables before session: overlap-matrix.xlsx (attached) showing local equivalents and attendee mapping; procurement pre-read (one page) for PO/terms. I'll create two calendar events (Week A/Week B) marked as recurring with "Week A / Week B" in the title so your procurement system can pick the initial occurrence for PO.

I'll draft the invites and include: Agenda, SE runbook (what we'll demo), and an access checklist for your infra team. Priyom — can you confirm procurement legal contact for DocuSign + who should receive the initial PO timeline? Laura, is this ok from an AE coverage perspective?

Regards,
